name: Kazama Satsuki
source:
Once a promising literary novelist, he quickly became disillusioned, and is now a popular writer of bondage porn.

Frequently spends late nights out for "work-related research," which is a source of conflict with his older brother, [url=http://vndb.org/c17606]Yukihiro[/url].
